Name: Magpie Trinket Companion
Author: tinymangodragon
Description:

[center][img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/a9b1aac079c5bf5b0c640480d7bb4549/121ff76621727328-ca/s250x400/d9ad595cce66b1c6427e965c94d65bfa57ea0940.pnj[/img][/center]

[b][size=4]Turn your parrot and fairy trinket companions into magpies with 17 different species to choose from![/size][/b]
Both the parrot and fairy can be enabled or disabled individually in case you only want to use this mod for one of them.

Species I chose to include and exclude:
[spoiler]Included in this mod:

(real)
[list]
[*]Asir Magpie[/*]
[*]Azure-winged Magpie[/*]
[*]Black-rumped Magpie[/*]
[*]Bornean Green Magpie[/*]
[*]Common Green Magpie[/*]
[*]Common Magpie/Eurasian Magpie[/*]
[*]Iberian Magpie[/*]
[*]Indochinese Green Magpie[/*]
[*]Maghreb Magpie[/*]
[*]Red-billed Blue Magpie[/*]
[*]Sri Lanka Blue Magpie[/*]
[*]Taiwan Blue Magpie[/*]
[*]White-winged Magpie[/*]
[*]Yellow-billed Blue Magpie[/*]
[*]Yellow-billed Magpie[/*]
[/list](fictional)
[list]
[*]Joja Magpie[/*]
[*]Void Magpie[/*]
[/list]
Excluded from this mod:
[list]
[*]Black-billed Magpie[/*]
[*]Oriental Magpie[/*]
[*]Javan Magpie[/*]
[/list]because I am unable to depict what distinguishes them from the other magpies already in this mod on a small sprite like that;

As well as
[list]
[*]Australian Magpie[/*]
[*]Black Magpies[/*]
[*]Magpie-Robins[/*]
[/list]because they are considered false magpies and not part of the family Corvidae.[/spoiler]

[b][size=4]Retexture and rename the Parrot Egg and Fairy Box trinkets![/size][/b]
The Parrot Egg can be renamed to Magpie Egg and retextured to an unused cream colored version of the default blue egg from the game's files. The Fairy Box can be renamed to Magpie Box and retextured to a Magpie themed box with a matching variant for every single magpie. You can either choose a specific one or have it automatically match your current magpie.


[b][size=4]Change the parrot squawk to a magpie call![/size][/b]
You can change the default squawk to a magpie call while in the valley. You can enable it for Ginger Island as well, however this also changes the sound of every wild parrot on the island to a magpie call since they all use the same sound path as the trinket. Note that I only included a Eurasian Magpie call because I was having difficulties finding sounds that were hq and free to use.

[center][img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/3023d8ad23c7f89ef35680f9e92d9db0/121ff76621727328-10/s400x600/62c2de4212afb8450d36396618a87e9c509850d4.pnj[/img][/center]

1. Make sure you have the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed.
2. Download this mod and extract the contents of the zip folder into your /Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run your game using SMAPI.


[center][img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/1cad61b063873f2f32f96aa3df173a4e/121ff76621727328-71/s500x750/4a47306fe6aa03a7f022a158dfb6f54df8a526e6.pnj[/img][/center]
[left] [/left]
Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] which gives you an in-game menu with check boxes and drop-downs to choose from. It can be accessed from the game's title screen or at the bottom of the game's options tab.
